title: Classify cube-zero local algebra isomorphisms (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. For every odd finite field K, split local commutative unital algebras with J^3=0 and one-dimensional socle J^2 have one isomorphism class when r=dim(J/J^2) is odd, and two when r is even. In the even case the determinant square class of the recovered multiplication form distinguishes them. The same signature classifies their multiplication tensors up to isotopy. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
supplied table -> radical and multiplication form -> canonical signature/chart
matching signatures -> explicit algebra isomorphism
```

This resolves one specified class of the recovered-algebra isomorphism question in Ali Romman's merged #5540. Its reconstruction theorem is cited, not audited. The new result is the specialization and complete constructive interface; finite-field symmetric-form theory is classical. Only `research/cube-zero-gorenstein-isomorphism/` is added.

## Evidence

Before, #5540 recovers commutative algebra tables and leaves their general isomorphism problem open. After, PROOF.md gives a complete classification for this restricted cube-zero class, and a standard-library implementation constructs exact maps from arbitrary-basis supplied tables.

Normal and optimized local checks report `PASS_CUBE_ZERO_GORENSTEIN_ISOMORPHISM`:

- 51,200 nonsingular symmetric forms with complete similarity certificates.
- Independent complete GL/similarity orbit generation: all 18/100/294 binary forms over F3/F5/F7, and all 468 ternary forms over F3, using 48/480/2016/11232 invertible matrices respectively. Here binary and ternary describe form dimension, not field characteristic.
- 96 arbitrary-basis algebra presentations and 4,128 transported basis products; 96 unit-image transporter mutations and 12 input/class rejection controls.
- Package metadata/provenance, committed bytes/modes/source-history and official export integrity pass. The optimized direct replay also passes from the read-only Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent; all eight exported files, including its generated export inventory, remain unchanged.

Every verifier run emits a generated receipt bound to all seven package files by SHA256. No predecessor scientific verifier is imported or replayed.

From the worktree root, CPython 3.12.15 and its standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/cube-zero-gorenstein-isomorphism/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/cube-zero-gorenstein-isomorphism/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cube-zero-gorenstein-isomorphism
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cube-zero-gorenstein-isomorphism --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Each registered command was timed locally: normal 6.114 seconds and optimized 6.127 seconds. Both full registered commands also pass through the package launcher. Warning-strict execution and AST compilation pass; no external static analyzer was available. No historical suites were run.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The proof covers all positive r and odd finite fields. The executable table API is bounded to odd primes 3 through 31 and dimensions 3 through 10. Characteristic two, nonsplit residue fields, larger socles and arbitrary algebra isomorphism remain outside the result. The predecessor tensor reconstruction is a credited premise rather than new coverage.

The emitted maps have no native coefficient, frame, storage, movement, dirty-restoration, precision or complete recursive tariff. No physical caller, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem follows. Lean, Docker and selected cold replays were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Extend this specific interface to characteristic two, beginning with alternating versus nonalternating multiplication forms. A separate proof and field contract are needed.
- Price one emitted map in an actual native caller, including legal coefficients, dirty inputs, every conversion and final restoration. No such tariff is supplied.

## Related open work

The completion refresh read the titles and bodies of all 12 other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this cube-zero Gorenstein isomorphism signature or computes a competing class count. No additional computations were run to check those contributions.

- #5947 proves a four-role call minimum over F2[S3]. It concerns a noncommutative register-word endpoint in characteristic two, rather than isomorphism of the split commutative local algebras classified here. No shared numerical result is compared.

No open PR studying this cube-zero Gorenstein isomorphism signature was identified in the live targeted title/body searches. #5540 is the merged predecessor. #5934 concerns Gaussian tensor-annihilator heights, a different tensor and quantity; no shared numerical result is compared and no extra computation was run to check it.

The live overlap refresh included open PRs, recent account contributions, handoff claims, active Discussions, main-tree object/formula searches and merged searches. Cached local coverage is sparse and was supplemented by Git-object searches; it is not a novelty certificate. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19220065). The delivered scope matches that claim. The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to this written algebraic side result, without claiming its proof-assistant acceptance gate.

Credit Ali Romman #5540 at 831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68 for the recovered-table interface and isomorphism handoff, apoursh #5502, Ali Romman #5525, Nick Petalas #5252, David Ganz and the retained tensor/algebra lineage. Symmetric-form reduction, finite local-algebra structure and unital isotopy are classical. No predecessor credit or source file is changed.

## CI notes

The completed check list was read once; the run is completed/success and its head matches the PR head. The registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized commands.

This certifies the bounded registered checks, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the all-dimension written proof. All local checks listed above also passed at this commit. No CI failure remains.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated. Seven new files in one opt-in research package. Reverting the package removes the new proof, implementation and replay registration; shared code and the selected frontier are unchanged.
